description: Use when you need to triage a CVE: description, CVSS per publisher, dates, CWE, key references, affected products, CISA SSVC, FIRST EPSS with a 30-day series and CISA KEV status in one call. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /vuln/cve, $0.005 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. One CVE id. For CVEs newly added to CISA KEV since a date use vuln_kev_new; for the vulnerabilities of a package version use package_risk. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.
name: vuln_cve
title: Vuln cve
